page_title: UDI 0-3 JUV | Udinese v Juventus 20/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Antonio Rapuano is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' The referee shows the yellow card to Manuel Locatelli (Juventus).
90+1' Udinese take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
85' It will be a substitution. Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) is ready to enter the pitch as Dusan Vlahovic walks off.
84' Udinese will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
84' Wojciech Szczesny (Juventus) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

83' Wojciech Szczesny pulls off a fantastic save! Nehuen Perez (Udinese) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the right post, but the effort is kept out. Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and releases a good shot to the right side of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Wojciech Szczesny shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop his effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
82' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
80' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) comes onto the pitch so that Federico Chiesa can be given a rest.
77' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Udinese.
77' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall charges down the ball. Udinese force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
76' Bremer (Juventus) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. Udinese are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
75' Today's match ends for Beto who will be replaced by Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese).
73' Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus) is unable to keep his close-range header down and sends the cross from Weston McKennie just over the bar.
71' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
71' Beto (Udinese) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.
70' Massimiliano Allegri prepares a substitution. Andrea Cambiaso is replaced by Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus).
69' The foul by Jordan Zemura (Udinese) was seen by Antonio Rapuano who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
67' Lazar Samardzic fires a cross into the middle of the box that Sandi Lovric (Udinese) gets on the end of, but he fails to properly control the header and it spins narrowly wide of the left post.
66' Substitution. Florian Thauvin makes way for Isaac Success (Udinese).
65' An attempted cross from Nehuen Perez (Udinese) is cleared.

63' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Wojciech Szczesny makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the left side of the goal.
59' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) picks up a pass and has an effort from the edge of the box, but Wojciech Szczesny gets down to his right to keep it out.
59' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) goes for goal with a shot from long range, but the effort flies painfully wide of the right post.
57' Andrea Sottil has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Joao Ferreira (Udinese) replacing Festy Ebosele.
56' The game is interrupted now, Festy Ebosele (Udinese) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
54' Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
51' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) swings in a cross from the corner, but Wojciech Szczesny reads it well and gathers the ball.

50' Udinese force their opponents to concede a corner. Florian Thauvin (Udinese) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
50' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
48' The corner is swung in but Udinese can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
46' Massimiliano Allegri makes a switch. Nicolo Fagioli is coming on in place of Fabio Miretti (Juventus) at the start of the second period.
46' Half-time substitution. Timothy Weah (Juventus) will not participate anymore and Weston McKennie is coming on.
46' Half-time substitution. Andrea Sottil decided to make a change. Hassane Kamara (Udinese) is replaced by Jordan Zemura.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Andrea Sottil probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Oier Zarraga (Udinese). He is replaced by Lazar Samardzic.
46' Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+7' The match has reached half-time.

45+3' 0 - 3 Goal! Andrea Cambiaso hands Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header into the right side of the goal. 0:3.
45+2' Udinese quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

45+1' A snap shot by Florian Thauvin (Udinese) from the edge of the area flies towards the right side of the goal, but Wojciech Szczesny produces a good save to thwart him. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Udinese.
45+1' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
45' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post.
43' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
40' Timothy Weah (Juventus) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
39' Timothy Weah (Juventus) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
38' Walace (Udinese) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.
37' Beto races towards the box before laying off to Oier Zarraga (Udinese), who picks it up but blazes a shot well over the bar from the edge of the box.
36' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) fails to deliver a cross from the free kick as his attempt is thwarted by the opposition's defence.
35' Danilo (Juventus) has tested the patience of referee Antonio Rapuano and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
34' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Wojciech Szczesny, who smothers the ball.
31' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) is booked.
28' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alex Sandro (Juventus) was quite harsh and Antonio Rapuano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
25' The referee blows for a cooling break.
25' Walace (Udinese) collects a wonderful lead pass and as he has a lot of space, smashes a terrific shot from long range. His shot goes painfully close to the crossbar!
23' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) tries to find Oier Zarraga, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
22' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
20' 0 - 2 Goal! Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Marco Silvestri into the bottom left corner.
20' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
19' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) handles the ball inside the box. PENALTY to Juventus! Great chance to score.
19' Juventus work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

18' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball goes out of play and Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.
17' One of the players from Juventus times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
17' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
15' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) tries to find Andrea Cambiaso, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
12' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Juventus was in an offside position.
9' The corner from Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) is cleared away by the defence.

9' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag and Juventus will take a corner.

7' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Marco Silvestri anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
6' Juventus are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
2' 0 - 1 GOAL! Federico Chiesa (Juventus) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 0:1.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Udinese will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Antonio Rapuano.
